evidence_quotes.quote: GU Roctane Energy Gel box of 24 x 32 g packets (768 g net) retailing at $72.00 USD on guenergy.com.

Per 32 g packet (Sea Salt Chocolate): 100 kcal, 19 g total carbs (7 g sugars), 1.5 g total fat, 0 g protein, 180 mg sodium, 55 mg potassium, 35 mg caffeine, 1,425 mg Roctane Amino Blend (L-Leucine, Taurine, L-Valine, Beta-Alanine, L-Isoleucine).
GU Roctane Energy Gels are Informed Choice certified, vegan, gluten-free, and kosher.
